findings.title: Full parse before idempotency check, no cap on reports
findings.evidence: readReport now computes the sha256 and calls isKnown(channelPath, hash) before UTF-8 decoding and parseReport. The service passes a prepared SELECT on channel_imports. scanZetelInbox enforces MAX_INBOX_REPORTS=200. Tests cover known-skip without parse and the cap.
findings.recommendation: None. See F006 for a side effect of how the cap is counted.

findings.title: Missing tests for rollback after addFile, hard link, FIFO, boundaries
findings.evidence: The test 'falha depois do addFile (INSERT em channel_imports)' uses a BEFORE INSERT trigger and asserts no zetel_files row, empty arquivos/relatorios and imagens/relatorios, and that the simulated error text is absent from logs. channel-inbox.test.ts covers hard link, FIFO and the exact 20 images / 10 MB boundary.

findings.title: PUT /api/settings saved channel_dir before other fields were validated
findings.evidence: channel_dir is validated early into a local variable and written only after all other validations, right before the 'Nada a salvar' check. A test confirms a 400 on another field leaves channel_dir untouched.

findings.title: Intermediate-directory TOCTOU between zetelInboxDir and file open (accepted residual)
findings.evidence: inbox/ and inbox/<slug>/ are verified by lstat/realpath and files are then opened by joined path; O_NOFOLLOW protects only the final component. Swapping a directory for a symlink in between requires local write access to the clone, which is already a trusted boundary.
findings.recommendation: Optionally open the directory with O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW and use openat-style access; Node does not expose this directly, so accepting the residual is reasonable.

findings.title: Revert to older hash is skipped while a newer version stays current; DB slug failing the regex gives 500
findings.evidence: The identity (zetel_id, channel_path, content_hash) is deliberately permanent per D6, so reverting a file to older content is skipped; documented by a test. zetelInboxDir throws a generic Error for a slug failing SLUG_RE, which the route turns into a 500; DB slugs come from slugify, so this cannot happen in practice.
findings.recommendation: Keep as documented behavior; optionally count an invalid slug instead of throwing.

findings.title: Report cap counts already-imported reports, so new reports can be permanently refused after 200
findings.evidence: In scanZetelInbox, read += 1 runs before readReport, so reports already known (skipped by hash) consume the MAX_INBOX_REPORTS budget. Entries are sorted by name and date-prefixed names put the newest last, so once inbox/<slug>/ holds more than 200 report files every later report is marked too_many_reports on every run.
findings.recommendation: Count against the cap only reports that go through parse, with a separate larger bound for hash-only reads, and update the test.

findings.title: Worst-case per-request cost remains high: up to 200 unknown 1 MB reports parsed synchronously and held in memory
findings.evidence: Each unknown valid 1 MB report takes about 2 s of remark time and scan.reports keeps every markdown string and parsed result until the import loop finishes. Impact is limited: the attacker needs control of the repo the user chose to clone, in a local single-user app.
findings.recommendation: Optionally process reports lazily one at a time and lower the per-run parse budget, reporting the remainder as deferred.

findings.title: addFile alterado para todos os uploads (temp+rename, tratamento de erro) alem do necessario para subpasta de canal
findings.evidence: O Escopo da tarefa 003 nao lista lib/ingestao-service.ts. A mudanca era necessaria para aceitar subdir/sourceKind/sourcePath (RF4/D7), mas tambem reescreveu o caminho comum de upload: copia via .tmp-<uuid> + rename, mkdirSync com erro generico, remocao da copia se o INSERT falhar, e exportou resolveSemColisao. Ha teste de nao regressao ('upload comum (sem canal) segue em arquivos/ sem temporario sobrando'), e os gates FULL passaram, entao nao ha defeito observado, apenas ampliacao de superficie em codigo FULL (escrita atomica).
findings.recommendation: Aceitar, registrando no handoff que a atomicidade de addFile foi estendida a todos os uploads por necessidade do rollback por relatorio (Riscos da tarefa). Nao requer retrabalho.

findings.title: Alteracoes fora da lista de escopo: timeout de teste em report-format e thresholds em vitest.config.ts
findings.evidence: O diff eleva o timeout do teste de 1 MB da tarefa 002 para 20 s (justificado em comentario: flakiness em test:ci paralelo), exporta IMAGE_NAME_RE em lib/report-format.ts e adiciona thresholds de cobertura por arquivo em vitest.config.ts. Nenhum aparece no Escopo da tarefa, mas todos sao de suporte direto (gate de cobertura FULL e estabilidade do gate), sem mudar comportamento de producao.
findings.recommendation: Nenhuma acao. Mencionar no handoff como suporte aos gates.

findings.title: Sem UI para configurar channel_dir; botao Importar relatorios retorna erro textual quando o canal nao esta configurado
findings.evidence: channel_dir so pode ser definido via PUT /api/settings (campo aceito e validado). O Escopo da tarefa 003 pede apenas o botao na aba Arquivos e lib/settings.ts, nao uma tela de configuracao. A SPEC (Rollout) preve 'Configurar canal' na UI do curador, que pertence a tarefa posterior (painel Curadoria). Sem canal, a rota devolve 400 com mensagem clara, exibida pelo botao.
findings.recommendation: Garantir que a tarefa 006 (ou outra) entregue a configuracao de canal na UI; nada a fazer na 003.
